name: Environmental 4.1.1
changelog:
* Added a config for Deer having/not having antlers
* Doubled Wisteria Sapling drop rates
* Fixed MuleArmorLayer mistakingly identifying itself as the crash when another mod crashes before it
* Fixed Leather Armor worn by Mules disappearing upon re-opening world
* Fixed some mixin crashes by switching to WrapOperation
* Fixed Zebroids not being able to use Farmer's Delight horse feed
* Fixed Mycelium Sprouts not being a Farmer's Delight compost activator
* Fixed a rare crash when Zebras are fleeing
* Fixed Slabfish not dropping leash when bucketed
* Fixed Koi Buckets not being able to be emptied by dispensers
* Fixed leaves not working with Fast Graphics
* Fixed Fallen Pine Trees erroring from placing in a far chunk

name: Environmental 4.1.0
changelog:
* Remodeled Yaks & improved AI
* Remodeled Ducks & improved AI
* Added Gallery support
* Added Helper Banner Pattern
* Added Baby Chicken texture
* Added Zebra sounds
* Added Zorses and Zonkeys
* Mules now have a lesser chest capacity but can wear leather horse armor
* Improved Deer fleeing and trusting mechanics
* Tweaked Wisteria trees to be noise based
* Tweaked Dwarf Spruce and Cup Lichen generation
* Fixed various issues with Serenity
* Fixed Delphiniums not having random offset
* Fixed Slabfish snacks being consumed twice
* Fixed Slabfish being unable to be fed Passion Fruits
* Fixed Pine and Wisteria hanging signs missing tags
* Fixed Slabfish backpacks not playing sound when dyed
* Fixed renaming a Slabfish resetting its texture
* Fixed Mud Balls not being craftable from Coarse and Rooted dirt
* Fixed Potted Cartwheels not being directional
* Fixed some issues with Slabfish dance animation
* Fixed Koi health being too high
